basic_details.job_title: MSSC Office Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 10 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Maharashtra State Security Corporation (Maharashtra Rajya Suraksha Mahamandal), the statutory corporation of the Government of Maharashtra, is engaging 10 Office Assistants (Karyalayeen Sahayak) on contract for 11 months at 25,000/- at its head office in Mumbai. Eligible men and women can apply through a Google form from 17 October 2026 to 9 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Open the Google form link given in the notice and submit your application there.
After applying, send the acknowledgement of your application to the email address [email protected].
Submit the application from 17 October 2026 to 9 November 2026, up to 18.00 hrs.
Bring the documents listed below when called for the interview.
MS-CIT, Tally and Advance Excel certificate
2 passport size photographs, PAN card and Aadhaar card

Contact for the interview: Police Director General and Managing Director, Maharashtra State Security Corporation, Centre-1, 32nd Floor, World Trade Centre, Cuffe Parade, Mumbai - 400 005. Telephone (022) 69965555, Fax (022) 69965599.
important_instructions: Candidates must attend the interview at their own cost. The number of posts shown in the notice may increase. The Mahamandal reserves the right to cancel, change or redo the selection process at any time, at any stage, fully or partly. The final decision on the selection of candidates rests with the Mahamandal.

content_sections.heading: About MSSC
content_sections.text: Maharashtra State Security Corporation is the statutory corporation of the Government of Maharashtra. Its head office is at Centre-1, 32nd Floor, World Trade Centre, Cuffe Parade, Mumbai - 400 005. The corporation is engaging Office Assistants in its head office departments.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for 10 Office Assistant posts, filled directly. A panel (waiting list) of 10 candidates will also be prepared for posts that arise within one year.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Age: minimum 25 years and not more than 40 years as on 31 October 2026. The notice does not list any age relaxation. Marathi typing 30 wpm and English typing 30 wpm; the GCC government-recognised examination must be passed. MS-CIT examination passed, with knowledge of MS Word / Excel and Advance Excel on the computer. At least 3 years' work experience as Office Assistant / Clerk / Typist in private or government / semi-government establishments. Marathi and English typing 30 w.p.m. MS-CIT certification and knowledge of MS Word, MS Excel and Advance Excel. 3+ years' experience in general or tax accounting. Hands-on experience in Tally ERP 9.0 Prime and with computerised ledger systems. Advanced knowledge of MS Office. GST, TDS, TDS under GST and Income Tax working; ledger and bank reconciliation, billing. Resolving audit queries, advance tax etc. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, and the ability to work well in a team. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Degree in any stream from a recognised university
Master's / bachelor's degree in accounting / MBA

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay is 25,000/-. The appointment is on contract for 11 months. Re-appointment may be given according to the Mahamandal's need, the ability and knowledge shown by the employee, and other criteria. A candidate selected as Office Assistant may be transferred from one department to another according to the office's need.

content_sections.heading: MSSC Office Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: Various kinds of work in departments such as Recruitment and Training, Administration, Establishment, Abhiyan and Establishment of Institutions, for example work on security recruitment process, training-related work, appointments, transfers, promotions, discipline-related work, and appointment letters and correspondence with outside establishments. Note writing, letter writing and report writing on the computer, for which basic computer knowledge is needed. Knowledge of basic bookkeeping and financial transactions, and familiarity with financial regulations, that is Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP). Booking of monthly sales and generating e-invoices; processing bills, cheques, receipts and other documents. Preparing accurate daily MIS / cash flow; daily or weekly account reconciliations and regular ledger maintenance. Payment of GST, TDS, advance tax and TDS under GST. Handling petty cash and passing the necessary entries in Tally. Verifying financial data, maintaining accurate records and reporting on the status of accounts and discrepancies. Following up with clients for recovery and resolving audit queries.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MSSC Office Assistant
content_sections.text: Open the Google form link given in the notice and submit your application there. After applying, send the acknowledgement of your application to the email address [email protected] . Submit the application from 17 October 2026 to 9 November 2026, up to 18.00 hrs. Bring the documents listed below when called for the interview. Personal information (bio-data) Educational documents Typing certificate Experience certificate MS-CIT, Tally and Advance Excel certificate 2 passport size photographs, PAN card and Aadhaar card Contact for the interview: Police Director General and Managing Director, Maharashtra State Security Corporation, Centre-1, 32nd Floor, World Trade Centre, Cuffe Parade, Mumbai - 400 005. Telephone (022) 69965555, Fax (022) 69965599.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: A list of candidates to be called for interview will be prepared from the documents received. Candidates who meet the minimum eligibility will be informed of the interview date by telephone and e-mail. A computer test will be held at the Mahamandal's office on Marathi and English typing (ISM Software), letter writing and noting, and on Word and Excel. The interview is held after the test. A panel (waiting list) of candidates will be prepared on the basis of typing, interview, experience and similar criteria. Appointment letters will carry the Mahamandal's terms and conditions. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must attend the interview at their own cost. The number of posts shown in the notice may increase. The Mahamandal reserves the right to cancel, change or redo the selection process at any time, at any stage, fully or partly. The final decision on the selection of candidates rests with the Mahamandal.

faq.question: Q1. How many Office Assistant posts has MSSC announced?
faq.answer: MSSC has announced 10 Office Assistant posts: 2 in Finance, 6 in Abhiyan and 2 in other departments. The notice says the number of posts may increase.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for MSSC Office Assistant?
faq.answer: The last date is 9 November 2026. The application period runs from 17 October 2026 to 9 November 2026, up to 18.00 hrs.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for MSSC Office Assistant?
faq.answer: For Abhiyan and other departments, a degree in any stream from a recognised university, Marathi and English typing at 30 wpm (GCC) and MS-CIT are needed. Finance posts need a master's or bachelor's degree in accounting or MBA.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for MSSC Office Assistant?
faq.answer: The age must be minimum 25 years and not more than 40 years as on 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for MSSC Office Assistant?
faq.answer: The pay is 25,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for MSSC Office Assistant?
faq.answer: Apply through the Google form link given in the notice. Then send the acknowledgement of the application to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for MSSC Office Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates meeting the minimum eligibility are called for a computer test on Marathi and English typing, letter writing, noting, Word and Excel, followed by an interview. A waiting list is prepared.

faq.question: Q8. Is the MSSC Office Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is on contract for 11 months. Re-appointment may be given according to the Mahamandal's need and the employee's ability and knowledge.

faq.question: Q9. How much experience is required for MSSC Office Assistant?
faq.answer: At least 3 years' experience as Office Assistant, Clerk or Typist is required. Finance posts need 3+ years' experience in general or tax accounting.

faq.question: Q10. Can an Office Assistant be moved to another department?
faq.answer: Yes, a selected candidate may be transferred from one department to another according to the office's need.
